traces.instrument_status: Current supervisory expectations; binding rule applicability not established
traces.scope_reason: Exact registry identity established; UK bank supervisory category supported by publisher disclosure. Binding Rulebook, regulator-register cross-check and institution-specific application remain unverified. Group ownership is not transferred into duties.
traces.consequence: Investigate whether critical-service dependency maps and recovery/exit exercises still demonstrate tolerances after technology or supplier changes. This is ongoing assurance, not evidence of a Lloyds deficiency.
traces.question: Which important service and legal entity, if any, has an evidenced dependency-testing gap that existing teams and suppliers cannot close? Ask the accountable resilience owner for current test outcomes before proposing work.

alternatives.interpretation: Existing internal capability may already satisfy the need
alternatives.test: Inspect current dependency maps, scenario tests and self-assessment; no deficient control is alleged.

alternatives.interpretation: Ongoing maintenance may require no external contract
alternatives.test: Check internal delivery and existing supplier coverage before suggesting procurement; the 2025 milestone has already passed.

limitations: Not a legal opinion or compliance certification.
No customer-confirmed gap, buying authority, budget, procurement or current supplier contract.
contradictions: A regulatory expectation does not establish unmet demand.

traces.instrument_status: Published national code provision; EU amendments and national implementation are separate
traces.scope_reason: French legal entity, consolidation perimeter, turnover/size thresholds, reporting phase and exemption are unresolved. No French Lloyds subsidiary or duty inferred. Official register acquisition blocked.
traces.consequence: Industry-only investigation: reporting teams may need reconciled consolidation-perimeter and sustainability data lineage. Group inclusion can exempt a consolidating group under V; no Lloyds effect established.
traces.question: Acquire an exact French register identity and accounts, then resolve current national thresholds, phase-in and consolidation exemption before asking any enterprise-specific commercial question.

alternatives.interpretation: Consolidated group reporting may remove a separate obligation
alternatives.test: Check controlling group inclusion and exemption conditions under V.

alternatives.interpretation: Unproven entity or phase-in may mean no applicable reporting project
alternatives.test: Obtain register identity, size and reporting period; do not infer from a group brand or country selection.

limitations: Industry-only trace, not a French Enterprise Twin or compliance decision.
EU 2026 amendment thresholds cannot be automatically substituted for current national law.
No existing UK hypothesis transplanted into France.
contradictions: Consolidation exemption and pending amended thresholds counter a blanket reporting-demand claim.
